0.name: Markers
0.content:
Available_Markers = [$Title, $Time, $Message] $Title[text] → Scene/act label $Time[text] → Timestamp $Message[Sender > text] → Outgoing bubble $Message[Sender < text] → Incoming bubble Nesting_Rule = Do NOT nest markers inside each other Prose_Rule = Markers sit between prose paragraphs, never mid-sentence Blank_Line = Not required between marker and prose — renderer handles spacing Direction_Key = ">" outgoing (sender wrote it) | "<" incoming (sender received it) Purpose = Convert line-start list markers (1. / -) to HTML via regex Key_Flag = m (multiline) — ^ matches start of EVERY line; without m, ^ matches only text start Option_A_Wrap_As_li: Find = /^(?:\d+\.|-)\s*(.+)$/gm Replace =
  • $1
    • Option_B_Styled_Bullet (text untouched): Find = /^(?:\d+\.|-)\s*/gm Replace = ▸  Note = bullet char/HTML swappable (•, —,
    , custom class) Option_C_Keep_And_Style_Marker: Find = /^(\d+\.|-)(\s*)/gm Replace = $1$2 SillyTavern_Regex_Extension: Find_Regex = ^(?:\d+\.|-)\s*(.*)$ Flags = gm (typed into flags field) JSON_Export = escape backslashes (\\d+) Placement = Only Format Display preferred (raw text stays for AI context); Only Format Prompt hides markers from model — usually bad, loses list structure Safety: Mid-line safe → 3.5, Mr. Han, false-start dashes (I- I didn't) untouched Risk = line-start dash (dialogue/stutter) WILL convert → tighten pattern to \s+ so bare "-word" survives Pending = User asked how to produce full HTML list (

1.name: Message Outgoing
1.content:
<html_marker_message_outgoing>
Syntax = $Message[SenderName > message text]
Use_For = [{{char}} sending texts, text messages by {{char}}, One-sided messages]
Rule = ">" operator = outgoing · Sender name before ">" · Message text after
Example = $Message[{{char}} > I'll be there before the clock strikes.]
</html_marker_message_outgoing>

2.name: Message Incoming
2.content:
<html_marker_message_incoming>
Syntax = $Message[SenderName < message text]
Use_For = [texts received by {{char}}, NPC messages, text received]
Rule = "<" operator = incoming · Sender name before "<" · Message text after
Example = $Message[Nick < You free today?]
Example = $Message[Inspector Greymoore < The body was found at half past nine.]
</html_marker_message_incoming>

3.name: Title
3.content:
<html_marker_title>
Syntax = $Title[label text]
Use_For  = [Scene headings, Location names, Act breaks, Chapter markers]
Rule = Inline within prose block · No block wrapping needed
Example  = $Title[The Parlour — Dusk]
</html_marker_title>

4.name: Time
4.content:
<html_marker_time>
Syntax = $Time[time string]
Use_For = [In-world clock, Scene timestamps, Elapsed time, Day markers, Time Skip]
Rule = Inline within prose block · Tabular numerals · Short strings preferred
Example  = $Time[11:47 PM]
Example  = $Time[Day 3 · Late Evening]
</html_marker_time>
